contract_parent: G8-Q2 OCR contract / G5-25D frozen OCR capability
preprocessing: in-memory RGB conversion only when needed
text_normalization: UTF-8, normalize line endings, remove NUL/replacement characters and trailing whitespace
page_marker_contract: source_page_kind=image_sequence; logical_page_number; source image path and SHA
provenance_contract: source image SHA -> logical page -> OCR text SHA -> derivative/Artifact SHA
source_image_sha: required and revalidated against page map
output_sha: SHA-256 for every page text, derivative manifest, and Artifact
idempotency: reuse derivative only when contract and ordered source SHA list match; write-if-changed
